description: React component for a roadmap page with milestones, stages, and role planning, including UI components and state management functions.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Parses a raw string into an array of strings, safely handling null and invalid JSON.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string with a given prefix.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between two bounds.

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns the current date in ISO format (yyyy-mm-dd).

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Calculates total, completed, in-progress milestones and overall percentage.

methods.name: progressRingTone
methods.description: Returns color styles for progress ring based on percentage.

methods.name: stageIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG icon component based on stage icon type.

methods.name: normalizeMilestonesForPathway
methods.description: Assigns stage labels to milestones based on index and title heuristics.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Custom hook to detect if user prefers reduced motion.

methods.name: useIntersectionReveal
methods.description: Custom hook to trigger class addition when element enters viewport.

methods.name: ProgressRing
methods.description: Component rendering a circular progress indicator with label.

methods.name: TagChip
methods.description: Component for rendering a styled tag label.

methods.name: StageNode
methods.description: Component representing a stage in the roadmap with icon and progress.

methods.name: MilestoneCard
methods.description: Component for displaying and toggling milestone completion.

methods.name: PathwayCareerTimeline
methods.description: Component displaying milestones organized by stages with progress summary.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a default role plan with milestones and skill deltas based on input.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads roadmap state from local storage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves roadmap state to local storage.

methods.name: buildCategoriesForRole
methods.description: Builds role-specific skill categories and subcategories for mind map visualization.
